verdict.rationale: Mercury advertises 'granular user permissions' and built-in permission tiers (e.g., accountant-only payment access) plus a Users resource in its CLI/API, indicating role-based access exists. However, there is no evidence of permissions being structured specifically across locations or departments, nor documentation of a role hierarchy or admin console for finance-leads to configure fine-grained scopes. missing for 10: documentation of location/department-scoped roles, a full permissions matrix or admin UI walkthrough, and independent verification of granularity beyond basic 'view/pay' distinctions.
